text:
lia: Heads-up — CS reports a spike of 503s from hosted inference customers in us-west-2 starting ~2026-03-17T10:42Z after the model swap to v3.2. Customer ticket: https://redwood.example/t/12345

oncall-bot: ALERT hosted-infer-prod — 503 rate increased 6x at 2026-03-17T10:42:12Z. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/hosted-503

ken: Seeing repeated pod restarts for infer-runner-*-usw2. kube events show CrashLoopBackOff; logs include GPU OOM and then segfault. Pod infer-runner-abc restarted 7x in 4m.

sophie: Noted. We rolled v3.2 at 10:40. Rolling back now unless we have mitigations. @ken can you grab dmesg + nvidia logs?

ken: dmesg excerpt:
```
[123456.789012] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, pid=23456, GPU has fallen off the bus
[123456.789110] oom_reaper: reaped process 23456 (infer-runner), nowanon
[123456.789200] segfault at 0 ip 00007f8a2b3c4d eip 00007f8a2b3c4d sp 00007ffdf3a1f0
```

ken: quick nvml snapshot before crash (from metrics):
```
GPU0 memory.used [MiB]: 17340 / 16384  <-- memory > total (fragmentation / accounting oddness)
GPU0 persistence mode: Enabled
GPU0 processes: infer-runner (PID 23456) 98% GPU util
```

lia: CS: customers see requests hang ~60-120s then 503s. This started immediately after the model swap. One large enterprise reported timeouts during a bulk batch call.

sophie: Hypothesis: model v3.2 changed context windows + kv-cache growth; combined with a new fused-attn kernel the runtime selects, causing memory fragmentation or an allocator regression on long-lived processes. Could be quantization path change too.

ken: Found a user pod coredump: /var/crash/infer-runner-abc/core. Minimal backtrace (from gdb):
```
#0  0x00007f8a2b3c4d in fused_attn_forward_kernel()
#1  0x00007f8a2b9f00 in run_inference_loop()
#2  0x00007f8a2bb0c5 in main
```

lia: Immediate mitigations requested by CS: reduce customer impact, notify affected customers, rollback if needed.

sophie: Applying hotfix config to hosted pools: reduce max_batch_size and disable kv_prefetch to lower peak resident set. Patch applied to canary then pool. Config snippet: `max_batch_size: 1, max_batch_tokens: 256, enable_kv_prefetch: false`

deploy-bot: config.patch hosted-infer/us-west-2 v3.2-hotfix applied to pool-2 at 2026-03-17T10:49:03Z. Rolling restart of runners initiated.

oncall-bot: Observability — 503 error rate trending down to baseline after config patch and rolling restarts. Monitoring window 15m.

ken: Post-action notes:
- Repro on staging when forcing long-running KV growth + repeated small batches -> OOM within ~3-5 minutes.
- Memory accounting sometimes shows used > total, suggests NVML sampling race or fragmentation.
- Core frames point at fused attention path.

sophie: Next steps: assign to eng-ml to bisect kernel selection + allocator behavior on v3.2 changes. Reproduce with sanitized prompt set and create a minimal repro harness. If confirmed, revert kernel or pin model variant.

lia: CS action items: send interim update to impacted customers (we've mitigated, rollback/patch applied; postmortem incoming). Liaison: @lia.

ken: Filing infra bug: INFRA-4721 — "v3.2 fused-attn memory regression causing upstream worker OOM/crash on hosted". Attaching dmesg, nvml snapshots, coredump pointer.

sophie: Thanks team — good triage. Will follow up with a postmortem and recommended guardrails (model swap automated load-check, canary long-run test). :thumbsup:

cs-rep: Customer update sent. Customers acknowledged; one requested dedicated postmortem for their SLA review.

lia: Closing thread once postmortem ticket created and CS follow-up scheduled. Thanks everyone.
